summary: First full E2E test after build. Backend 22/22 pytest passing (all /api/meta, /api/config CRUD+validate, /api/basket/preview for ATM/OTM/DELTA/PREMIUM and hedge-disabled, /api/backtest/run, /api/session PAPER lifecycle incl. INITIAL ENTRY + ROLL + close-before-open ordering + emergency, LIVE gating without Upstox connect, /api/upstox status/login/callback/funds/positions). Frontend: all 8 sidebar tabs switch views correctly; Strategy Config preview + save work; Backtest run populates stats + equity chart; PAPER session Start Algo reaches ACTIVE_BASKET with 4 legs (SELL CE, SELL PE, BUY CE HEDGE, BUY PE HEDGE) rendered in four-leg-basket-panel, ATR band chart + INITIAL ENTRY orders visible, basket-pnl-display shows value, all 5 bottom terminal tabs present. LIVE-mode confirm modal shows and Arm button correctly disabled until checkbox checked.

minor.issue: After a session completes/exits, `state` remained 'WAITING' in some observed status snapshots instead of transitioning to COMPLETED before the next tick populated it. Non-blocking; eventually reflects COMPLETED.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows algo-status-badge='ALGO LIVE' and orders/legs immediately, but the strategy-state-badge text sometimes lags reaching 'ACTIVE_BASKET' (~30-60s stale) compared to API. Polling cadence in App.js could be tighter.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Ensure SessionManager sets state=COMPLETED (or EXITING) when the synthetic day loop terminates, so status reflects terminal state immediately.
OPTIONAL: Reduce frontend session-status polling interval or update state badge from same payload the panel already receives to avoid perceived lag.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes route handlers and validation in a single file; consider splitting into routers per domain (config, basket, backtest, session, upstox) as the file grows.

basket_preview returns leg['role'] as str(LegRole.SHORT_CE) which may serialize as 'LegRole.SHORT_CE' vs 'SHORT_CE' depending on enum config; tests handle both, but frontend/back should agree on a single canonical form.
No auth or rate-limit on any /api endpoint — acceptable for personal tool but should be documented.
test_upstox_login previously asserted 400 (not configured) but credentials ARE configured; fixed to assert 200 URL and added invalid-state callback test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (LIVE OAuth completion intentionally not tested)

test_credentials: N/A (no app login). Upstox is currently CONNECTED server-side (a token exists in Mongo) so LIVE-not-connected UI gating could not be observed; LIVE confirm modal + arm-disabled-until-checkbox flow verified instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v (needs ~3 min due to two PAPER session lifecycle tests). Upstox may show CONNECTED (a token was saved in Mongo during prior manual OAuth). To force NOT CONNECTED, call POST /api/upstox/disconnect. Session emergency events observed during tests were user-triggered (browser panic button) — SessionManager itself does not auto-emergency. Synthetic PAPER day: INITIAL ENTRY around 40-60s after session start, several rolls, then COMPLETED at ~2-3 min.
